name: University of West London

facts.text: UWL has campuses in Ealing and Brentford in west London, and in Reading in Berkshire.
facts.sourceTitle: Our campus and sites | University of West London (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: The Ealing site's main address is St Mary's Road, Ealing, W5 5RF; its teaching buildings are about a 10-minute walk from Ealing Broadway station (Central and District lines, Elizabeth line and National Rail).
facts.sourceTitle: Studying at UWL Ealing site | University of West London (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: The Ealing site has had a GBP 50 million transformation including a refurbished Students' Union, music studios, an auditorium and the Paul Hamlyn library.
facts.sourceTitle: Studying at UWL Ealing site | University of West London (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: The Brentford site, called Paragon (Boston Manor Road, TW8 9GA), is 1.5 miles south of the Ealing site and linked to it by a free 10-minute shuttle bus.
facts.sourceTitle: Our campus and sites | University of West London (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: The Reading site at Fountain House in Reading town centre hosts nursing and midwifery courses delivered in partnership with the NHS.
facts.sourceTitle: Our campus and sites | University of West London (search snippet; page not fetched)
